The '''Void Anvil''' was a planned mining station and [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] designed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The plans for the station were stolen by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Rimark]], but the Republic recovered them when Tarn [[Battle in the Thanium sector|attempted]] to sell them in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]].<ref name="TOR:TD">{{TORcite|type=space|Thanium Disruption}}</ref>
